name: Dark Veil
description: WebGL2 shader background that renders a flowing, glowing veil of light in a chosen color, with pointer-reactive distortion, a soft intro fade-in and optional light-mode ink rendering.
contents: Container div filling its parent with one absolutely positioned WebGL canvas
Neural-network generated field shader plus a composite shader for glow, sheen, grain and edge fade
behavior: Veil drifts and morphs continuously over time at the given speed
Pointer movement over the page bends, rotates and drags the veil and moves a highlight light
Intro fades and unfolds the veil in over 1.8 seconds
Rendering pauses when offscreen or the tab is hidden and resumes automatically
Respects reduced motion: no animation, no intro, no pointer interaction
Re-renders when props change without recreating the WebGL context
editableByProps: Veil color, brightness, glow, sheen and grain
Animation speed, flow, warp, scale, rotation and a variation seed for different shapes
Pointer interaction on or off and its strength, intro on or off, paused state
Edge fade, overall opacity, and light-mode rendering for light page backgrounds
Render quality and pixel ratio for performance

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the veil pattern or its fixed base look
needsCodeEdit.where: cppn function in the FIELD shader string and the uSeed values in render

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the maximum internal field resolution
needsCodeEdit.where: MAX_FIELD_PIXELS constant and the resize function

needsCodeEdit.change: Listen to pointer only inside the container instead of the whole window
needsCodeEdit.where: window pointermove listener and onPointerMove in the useEffect

fixed: Needs a parent with a defined height, root is h-full w-full and collapses otherwise
Requires WebGL2, renders nothing if unavailable or shader compile fails, no fallback
Listens to window pointermove and documentElement pointerleave while mounted, removed on unmount
Pointer effects apply even when the pointer is over content above the canvas
Dark mode output is bright light on a transparent background, best on dark pages, use lightMode for light pages
Canvas device pixel ratio is capped at 2 and internal field pixels capped near 900000
Several props are clamped in code, for example quality 0.25 to 1, fade and opacity 0 to 1
Heavy GPU shader, may be slow on low-end mobile, lower quality to compensate
Layout is container-sized with ResizeObserver, works on mobile, tablet and desktop
